paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Expert win rates 0.90\% in EBS feedback judgment. Our annotations achieve an average win rate of 88.890.90\%. All 12 LLMs exceed an 820.90\% rate in preferring our EBS.
model_annotation: This bar graph illustrates the expert win rates for various large language models (LLMs) in a knowledge-grounded discussion summarization benchmark. The vertical axis represents the expert win rate as a percentage, ranging from 0% to 100%, with increments of 20%. The horizontal axis lists the names of the LLMs and the average win rate. Each LLM is represented by a bar of a distinct color, with corresponding numerical values indicating its win rate. The bars are not sorted in any specific order. The average win rate is 88.89%, and all LLMs have win rates above 82%, with GPT-4o-mini having the highest win rate at 97.56% and DeepSeek-V3 having the lowest at 82.26%.

model_annotations.English:
The chart illustrates the expert win rates of various Large Language Models (LLMs) in a knowledge-grounded discussion summarization task. The horizontal axis lists the names of the LLMs and the average, with no apparent order or scale type indicated. The vertical axis represents the Expert Win Rate (%), with a label, a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, and marked with tick labels at intervals of 20, with units of percentage. 

The chart displays 13 bars, each representing a specific LLM or the average, with distinct colors. Starting from the left, the bars are labeled as follows: Average (dark gray, approximately 88.89), GPT-4o (not visible, assumed to be around 84.38), GPT-4o-turbo (greenish, approximately 91.67), GPT-4o-mini (blue, approximately 97.56), Claude 3 Opus (purple, approximately 83.12), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (pink, approximately 88.46), Claude 3.5 Haiku (brown, approximately 86.25), Gemini 1.5 Pro (light blue, approximately 87.04), Llama3.1-405B (light purple, approximately 97.14), Mistral Large (beige, approximately 91.14), DeepSeek-V3 (gray, approximately 82.26), Qwen-Max (light beige, approximately 85.07), and GLM-4-Plus (pinkish, approximately 92.54). Notably, the bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
